message:
fix(apk): a queued X down whose up is refused at the entry is cancelled -- it never goes alone (keepalive-r2 e r4, Codex apk_xfence r3 N1)

A down admitted while the host took X waited in the queue; the host stopped taking X and the up was
refused at the entry (not queued); X came back before the sender reached the down, which then went
with no up after it (Codex probe: down_entry 1, up_entry 0, later_down_send 1, debt 1). The
controller now notes each queued X down's sequence (NoteQueued); an up refused at the entry cancels
the still-unsent downs of its button by sequence, and the sender drops a cancelled down (its held bit
hidden until the next press). A down already taken by the sender is not cancelled -- it is owed once
answered, as in r3. A quick pair (down and up both queued) is untouched. No-X wire exception: none.

Test: 75/75 x6 (new: the phase through the real controller -- the sender kept busy by late-answered
keys so Ping B is held with the down still queued, Pong A no X, the up refused, Pong B X: no X1 down,
no X1 up, the move without X1, a park confirms with nothing to release, the next quick pair whole;
and the ledger alone: cancel, quick pair, in-flight down owed). Without the queued-down record (the
7c5d027 behaviour): 3 FAIL, an orphan X1 down on the wire and a park release owed. 21 consumer
targets build; role_park 13/13, prelogin_select 60/60.
